review.scopeLimit: This closes durable viewport restoration inside Chat; unrelated screen state, IME behavior, authenticated backend behavior and cross-process browser coordination are not claimed.

notes: The shared Chat root stores either Latest or an authoritative non-local message anchor plus a density-independent offset under the existing actor-generation and conversation custody.
Restoration waits for the durable read. An explicit focused-message deep link wins, while a missing anchor pages through real history until it appears or history is authoritatively exhausted.

A recoverable history failure falls back visually without deleting or indirectly overwriting the durable anchor. ChatUiState keeps the protection across recomposition, and only an explicit user scroll re-enables persistence.
Leave, delete and actor retirement clear the viewport through the existing custody path, and close waits for the last queued viewport write.
The affected common model and Compose UI classes passed in Chrome Headless and iOS x64; the Android product compiled on the exact Product SHA. No backend state or credentials were used.
Independent review found and required fixes for recoverable-failure deletion, automatic Latest overwrite and host-recomposition loss. The final Product SHA received GO with no P0-P3 findings.

Product SHA c2f0916ec recomposes the unchanged viewport-restoration runtime onto main after #497 merged. All nine changed feature source and test paths are byte-identical to the preceding recomposed Product SHA 5116ac033 and the original reviewed Product SHA 5d28e420. The historical evidence report remains bound to report Git HEAD 95b31dc8; attestation bindings were renewed, and no platform matrix was repeated solely for the base advance.
